purpose: Validate coverage, physical file presence and reference integrity for the canonical classroom-task runtime set.

reference_checks.rule: Every runtime task concept_id resolves to concept_taxonomy.json.
Every runtime teaching_move_id is canonical; restored files were normalised before release.
Runtime representation IDs resolve through the registered representation catalogs/aliases.
Task source IDs resolve to registered curriculum, guidance or research sources; source attachment supports rationale and does not turn the task into a claimed national norm.
Superseded files are excluded by the runtime manifest.
Tasks with framework timing differences retain evidence notes or are gated by grade_resolution_rules.json.
Every runtime base task and Chinese overlay path physically exists on the release branch.

language_note: Task titles/prompts are bilingual and the Chinese runtime overlays provide Chinese purpose/use-when/expected-thinking/listen-for/variation fields for the core task set; the Chinese UI must prefer those stored overlays instead of live translation.
